props.title: Indian Wells Implements Two Madison AI Assistants to Streamline Operations

blocks.text: The City of Indian Wells, California , has partnered with Madison AI to launch two artificial intelligence (AI) assistants to support municipal functions: citywide administration and Public Records Act (PRA) requests.

These tools are engineered to help staff navigate extensive archives, process public inquiries faster, and unlock historical information, ensuring the City continues to deliver top-tier service to its residents.

We are excited to implement this technology as part of our ongoing efforts to modernize operations and reduce administrative burdens. By transforming legacy data into a searchable and actionable resource, Madison AI enables us to unlock new value and better support our teams.
blocks.attribution: Nick Werner, Indian Wells IT and Risk Manager

photo.alt: Nick Werner, Indian Wells IT and Risk Manager

blocks.title: The City of Indian Wells’ Madison AI models each serve a distinct purpose:

items.title: The Citywide Assistant
items.description: Provides administrative support across all departments, assisting employees to instantly locate internal policies, draft documents, and streamline daily workflows.

items.title: The PRA Assistant
items.description: Is trained to accelerate the Public Records Act fulfillment process, quickly isolating relevant documents from archives and ensuring timely, accurate responses to public inquiries.

blocks.text: Anchored by the City’s historical databases and foundational records, both assistants are synced regularly to maintain total accuracy. By breathing new life into older, complex data and automating the retrieval processes, Madison AI reduces the burden on Indian Wells personnel and empowers them to dedicate more time to community initiatives.

We are delighted to welcome the City of Indian Wells to the Madison AI family and support their full-scale deployment. Transforming disorganized data into a highly accessible resource is exactly where our platform shines. We look forward to seeing how these tools elevate the daily experience for their dedicated staff.

blocks.text: About the City of Indian Wells, California

Nestled in a cove of the Santa Rosa Mountains, the city of Indian Wells, California, blossoms with palm trees, gardens and lush, breathtaking scenery in all directions and features some of Greater Palm Springs’ most luxurious resorts offering world-class dining, spas, golf, tennis, and meeting facilities—yet is just a 20-minute drive from the Palm Springs International Airport. World-class cultural and sporting events and attractions, including BNP Paribas Open, Desert Town Hall and more, which bring tens of thousands of visitors, athletes, and epicureans to the city each year. 36 holes of championship golf with our newly renovated Players Course, invite visitors to tee off where the likes of Arnold Palmer and President Dwight D. Eisenhower once played and now the Epson Tour Championship. And with its unmatched collection of spectacular accommodations and pampering spas, the options for finding your own oasis are as endless as the city’s pristine views and blue skies. www.VisitIndianWells.com and www.CityofIndianWells.org.

Madison AI is the AI engine for local government. Using enterprise data and systems of record, Madison AI’s suite of purpose-built artificial intelligence assistants is designed to support the primary internal functions of local government.

These include assistants for the Office of the City Manager, Community Development, Procurement, and related operational areas. Madison AI accelerates administrative tasks, such as preparing staff reports, generating zoning verification letters, and drafting requests for proposals, using the agency’s own enterprise data to ensure accuracy and reliability.

Co-founded by Washoe County and trusted by nearly 50 local governments, Madison AI supports public-sector staff by reducing administrative workload and enabling teams to direct more time to serving their communities.
